idea-plugin.name: Phantom Redis
idea-plugin.description: A Redis browser and console for Phantom: keys found with SCAN and a pattern (never KEYS *), values of every type (strings with JSON indented, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, streams), delete, and a command line with redis-cli style output and history. Speaks the Redis protocol itself, with password, ACL user, database and TLS. The connection opens only while the Redis tool window is shown.
